scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @concord/server
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @concord/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,desktop -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @concord/server" "npm run dev -w @concord/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @concord/shared && npm run build -w @concord/server && npm run build -w @concord/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @concord/shared && npm run typecheck -w @concord/server && npm run typecheck -w @concord/desktop
scripts.test:server: npm run build -w @concord/shared && npm run test -w @concord/server
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:shared && npm run dist:win -w @concord/desktop
